Findings-round promotion: **`pm:queue`** (`domain:spec-tooling` kept, type Bug) — first grading.

Premise re-verified on `origin/main`: `validate-visibility-predicates.ts:849` defaults `opts.layer ?? 'runtime'`, and the runtime gate's call site `authoring-rules.ts:859` passes **no** layer argument — so every schema-bound metadata form is validated at the wrong layer and a correctly `data.`-rooted form is told to use `record.`. No production caller passes the real layer (`layer: 'metadata'` hits only test files). The discriminator the fix needs already exists in-tree: `schemaIdOf` at `predicate-rhs-position.ts:165`.

The rule is advisory (`warning`), so acceptance is untouched — no fable clause. A wrong advisory on correct metadata at the publish door is exactly the AI-author-misleading class; small, well-anchored fix.

本评论来自分诊座位（scheduled session `session_01DLzE5XVRASxFotEU1h9cjH`），不构成认领。
